/community/explore.comment: The public hub, measured where `/community` used to be: same shell, same assistant door (ADR-0143), same pinned own row (ADR-0172). It draws no per-viewer control, and the client read that fed one is gone (ADR-0173): measured 265.2 KB after the fix, against 299.1 KB while the roster fetched its states in the browser. The ceiling sits just above today's measurement, as before. Raised from 266 to 268 KB when card excerpts started linking URLs and member handles (ADR-0192): measured 266.6 KB, and the first version of that read cost 32 KB until the client call stopped validating its own reply with zod. Raised from 268 to 270 KB when the post card split its footer into a meta line and an action bar (views, relative time, and the like/comment cells the product intends): measured 268.1 KB, so the ceiling sits just above today's measurement, as before. Raised from 270 to 271 KB after later community work took the measured route to 270.1 KB on `main` before this change; a build with this branch's dropdown fix reverted measured the same 270.1 KB, so the fix adds no bytes to this route. Raised from 271 to 273 KB for the field vitals reporter and the single-render roster. The local build measured 271.4 KB and the CI runner measured 272.2 KB for the same commit, so 273 is the ceiling that keeps the usual small headroom across both machines instead of failing a performance change on runner noise.

/scan.comment: The Scanner owns no server surface, so its budget is the initial bundle alone: the decoder and the result card are lazy, and the ~1 MB WASM engine is a static asset fetched only once a visitor actually scans.

/habitflow.comment: Measured so the per-surface split (#497) is visible on a product route, not only on public ones. Its client bundle is the product's own and belongs to #493; these two ceilings sit a few percent above today's measurement so the route is guarded against growth without claiming a target it was never given. The JS ceiling moved from 365 to 372 when the minor-and-patch dependency group (Next 16.4.6 among 29 updates) took the route from 362.6 KB to 365.3 KB gzip on the runner; the headroom stays at the same few percent.
